headline: BlackRock Reduces Stake in Brazilian Water Utility Copasa to Under 5%
summary: Copasa announced that investment manager BlackRock reduced its aggregated stake in the company's ordinary shares to 18,960,416 shares, representing approximately 4.986% of the total voting stock.
why: Significant ownership disclosures by institutional asset managers signal shifts in major institutional positioning in publicly traded utilities.
